grammar_language_relation.statement: The CFG/WELL-EBNF-1 artifact defines a deliberately canonical generation surface for ClosedNormalizedProgram JSON texts. It is NOT required to equal the set of every byte string the pinned JSON parser accepts.
permitted_canonical_lexical_narrowing: Q2 fixed property order for schema-closed objects
Q10 zero insignificant whitespace between structural tokens
R3 exclusion of non-JSON NaN/Infinity/-Infinity lexical aliases from number productions
forbidden: silent widening beyond the frozen structural contract

authority_split.grammar: canonical structural + lexical generation surface as frozen
authority_split.json_parse: materialize JSON values from admitted texts
authority_split.freeze_candidate: authoritative closed-model validation, canonicalization, finite numeric rejection

numeric_lexical_authority.grammar_admits: strict JSON-number lexical syntax as in ECMA-404 / RFC 8259 number production (optional minus; int; optional frac; optional exp)
grammar_rejects: and case variants of those aliases
numeric_lexical_authority.freeze_admits_or_rejects: finite representability and ClosedNormalizedProgram field validity after parse; overflow-to-inf lexemes such as 1e309 may be syntactically grammar-legal JSON numbers and are decided by freeze_candidate/json.dumps(allow_nan=False) path
numeric_lexical_authority.harness_note: freeze.py uses json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False); harness rejects non-finite canonicalization
numeric_lexical_authority.q6_clarification: Q6 'full numeric lexical fidelity' means full strict JSON-number spelling surface under the pinned path, NOT Python json.loads nonstandard NaN/Infinity aliases
numeric_lexical_authority.t15_unchanged_except_clarity: integer vs number still derived from schema + pinned authoritative acceptance; integer sites must not invent convenience regex that contradicts pinned path

well_ebnf_1.eof: file MUST end with a single LF; no trailing blank line beyond that terminator

byte_level_metasyntax.note_rule_line: Each Rule occupies exactly one physical line. No line wrapping.
byte_level_metasyntax.AtomSuffix_note: Suffix operators bind to the immediately preceding Atom only (Identifier, Literal, CharClass, or Group). Written without space before the suffix.
byte_level_metasyntax.bounded_repeat_semantics: Atom{m,n} means between m and n inclusive repetitions of Atom; require 0 <= m <= n; n must be finite
byte_level_metasyntax.LitChar: unescaped Unicode scalar except U+0000..U+001F, U+0022, U+005C | Escape
byte_level_metasyntax.ClassAtom: unescaped Unicode scalar except U+0000..U+001F, U+005D, U+005C, U+002D | Escape
byte_level_metasyntax.Escape_u_semantics: \\uXXXX denotes Unicode scalar U+XXXX for XXXX in 0000..D7FF or E000..FFFF; surrogate code units alone are ILLEGAL in WELL-EBNF-1 terminals
byte_level_metasyntax.Escape_U_semantics: \\UXXXXXXXX denotes Unicode scalar U+XXXXXXXX for valid scalar values 00000000..0010FFFF excluding surrogates
forbidden_in_formatting: multiple consecutive SP where only one SP is specified
SP at start or end of a Rule line

well_ebnf_1.rule_ordering: Rules MUST appear in deterministic generator-defined order: (1) START first if present as Identifier START; (2) then productions sorted by Identifier lexicographic UTF-8 byte order; OR generator emits a pinned topological order documented in generator provenance. The chosen ordering algorithm MUST be recorded in T18 provenance as rule_order_spec and must be pure.
well_ebnf_1.rule_order_spec_default: START first; remaining Identifiers ascending by UTF-8 code unit sequence
well_ebnf_1.start_symbol: The grammar MUST contain exactly one production with Identifier START. START ::= ClosedNormalizedProgram ;  (or the root object nonterminal name if ClosedNormalizedProgram is inlined—but T16 requires sole entry START).
well_ebnf_1.equivalence: Two WELL-EBNF-1 files define the same dialect text iff their UTF-8 bytes are identical after the formatting rules above.
